theme: Light mode only (per explicit user instruction 'Fundo branco').

rules: BANNED: Inter for headings. Use Outfit with tracking-tight (-0.02em) for all headings to give a modern, authoritative directory feel.
Body text must be DM Sans, starting at text-base for maximum mobile legibility.
H1 Size: text-4xl sm:text-5xl tracking-tight leading-none.
Store Names (H2): text-xl sm:text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight.

grids_and_layouts.global: Mobile-first absolute priority. On desktop, constrain the main layout to max-w-2xl or max-w-3xl to maintain the tight, focused search experience.
grids_and_layouts.spacing_system: Use generous padding. Standard card internal padding is p-6. Main section gaps are gap-8.
grids_and_layouts.search_hero: Flex column, items-center, justify-center, min-h-[70vh]. Everything center-aligned ONLY on the homepage.
grids_and_layouts.results_feed: grid grid-cols-1 gap-4. Content inside cards must be left-aligned for scannability.

components.search_input: Massive input. h-16 or h-20, text-lg, rounded-2xl or rounded-full, border-2 border-gray-200 focus:border-[#FF5A00] focus:ring-0. Left icon: Large orange magnifying glass.
components.store_card: Cardless/Flat approach with 1px border. bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-2xl p-5 sm:p-6. No heavy shadows, maybe shadow-sm on hover. Left-aligned content.
components.badges: Selo Parceiro: bg-[#FFF0E5] text-[#FF5A00] text-xs font-bold px-3 py-1 rounded-full inline-flex items-center gap-1.
components.buttons: Smooth rounded-xl or rounded-full. Primary search button is bold Orange. Contact buttons use brand colors (WhatsApp green, Instagram gradient) or minimal gray outlines for 'Como chegar'.

visual_enhancers.icons: Use lucide-react. The logo is a Lucide 'Search' icon, size 48px or 64px, color #FF5A00, raw on the white background.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Keep it flat. Only use soft ambient shadows (shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)]) for sticky headers or modals.

motion.interactions: Native mobile feel. active:scale-[0.98] on all buttons and cards. transition-transform duration-200.

accessibility.contrast: All text must pass WCAG AA. Orange #FF5A00 against white passes for large text, but for body text use #111111.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid. Example: data-testid='search-input', data-testid='store-card-whatsapp-button'.

media.images: NO PRODUCT PHOTOS as per requirements. Stores can use Avatar components (Initials) to keep the UI purely typographic and clean.

3d_libraries.usage: NONE. This is a hyper-fast, objective local search tool. 3D would violate the 'simples, rápido e objetivo' constraint.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. STRICT: Do not build an e-commerce, marketplace, or feed. This is a local directory search MVP.
2. The homepage must be extremely clean (Google-style): Logo, Title, Slogan, Central Search Bar, Search Button, Subtext. Nothing else.
3. Ensure the mobile experience is flawless (mobile-first). Inputs should not zoom on focus in iOS (ensure text size is 16px+).
4. WhatsApp and Instagram buttons should use <a> tags with target='_blank' and proper href formats (wa.me/... or instagram.com/...).
5. The Admin panel is a simple CRUD for stores and products, protected by a basic login.
6. Use Tailwind and Shadcn UI. Override Shadcn default styling to match the flat, #FF5A00 orange theme with generous border-radius (rounded-2xl).
7. Implement light mode ONLY. The user explicitly requested 'Fundo branco' and minimal elements.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Do not apply `transition: all`. Use specific transitions like `transition-colors` or `transition-transform`.
Do not center align the app container in CSS. Left-align text by default, center ONLY the homepage search section.
Every interaction needs a micro-animation (hover state, active state scale).
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
